LanguageData.Gun_MP7_RWP.description: The MP7 is a compact, lightweight submachine gun designed for close-quarters combat. It offers a high rate of fire with low recoil, making it ideal for short-distance engagements. This weapon's rapid rate of discharge can overwhelm unarmored targets quickly, but its short range limits its effectiveness against distant foes.
